game: New Play Control! Mario Power Tennis
project: New Play Control! Mario Power Tennis native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays an Exhibition singles match at 60 fps, no graphics errors seen. Tested on Windows 11 and on the Linux mini PC by playing into the first real scene (mini PC: an Exhibition singles match, 58.7 fps, no frame over 34 ms). Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
